EC4: Subjects that are unable to lay flat [AND] due to pulmonary complications [OR], increased intracranial pressure (ICP) [OR], or unstable spinal cord injuries
EC5: Subjects with known cardiac abnormalities (atrial septal defects [OR] or ventricular septal defects [OR], severe tricuspid valve disease [OR], severe pulmonary hypertension [OR], Ejection fraction < 15%)
EC7: Subjects with known upper extremity deep vein thromboses (subclavian [OR] or distal)
EC8: Subjects with non-functional CICC [OR] or PICC distal ports
